correctness.rationale: For A=D-E-F with L=D^{-1}E, U=D^{-1}F nonnegative and L^q=0, direct two-sweep algebra gives x(2)=omega[R+(1-omega)R^2+omega RUR]D^{-1}b. The coefficient of (omega L)^j in the non-backtracking part is j+2-(j+1)omega, nonnegative for all 0<=j<q exactly when omega<=1+1/q (in the range omega>1). The RUR term is nonnegative. Since q<=n, the stated sufficient frontier holds. On the SPD tridiagonal path, the (n,1) response equals omega^n epsilon^(n-1)(n+1-n omega)+O(epsilon^(n+1)), strictly negative for all omega>1+1/n when epsilon is sufficiently small. Strict positive RHS and exact solution are obtained by continuity and the nonnegative Neumann inverse. 11,368 exact rational assertions verified finite cases. The infinite theorem is proved symbolically in the text, not inferred from sampling.
